entity: HOLC-graded (1930s redlining map) neighborhoods nationwide: density of toxic-release/industrial plants by grade A to D, present day
what_we_add: TRI plants per 100 km2 by grade: D 13.35, C 5.82, B 2.21, A 0.07; D denser than B in 119 of 212 cities
why:
Lane et al. 2022 finds D-grade areas nearer more industrial sources, rising A to D: same grades, same direction, no density numbers. NPR and RAND agree in direction.
